english: In a triangle $ABC$, $\sin A:\sin B:\sin C=7:8:9$. Let $I$ be the incentre of the triangle. If $CI=2\sqrt{14}$, then the perimeter of the triangle $ABC$ is ______.
hindi: एक त्रिभुज $ABC$ में $\sin A:\sin B:\sin C=7:8:9$ है। माना $I$ त्रिभुज का अन्तःकेन्द्र है। यदि $CI=2\sqrt{14}$ है, तो त्रिभुज $ABC$ का परिमाप ______ है।
solution: Incircle touches $CA$ at $E$ with $CE=s-c$ and $IE\perp CA$, $\angle ICE=\dfrac C2$: $CI=\dfrac{s-c}{\cos\frac C2}=3k\cdot\dfrac{\sqrt{14}}{3}=\sqrt{14}\,k$
solution_full: By the sine law $a:b:c=\sin A:\sin B:\sin C=7:8:9$. Write $a=7k$, $b=8k$, $c=9k$ with $k>0$.

Half-angle formula: $\cos\dfrac C2=\sqrt{\dfrac{s(s-c)}{ab}}=\sqrt{\dfrac{12k\cdot3k}{56k^2}}=\sqrt{\dfrac{9}{14}}=\dfrac{3}{\sqrt{14}}$; the same value follows from $\cos^2\dfrac C2=\dfrac{1+\cos C}{2}=\dfrac{9}{14}$.
Let the incircle touch $CA$ at $E$. The tangent length from $C$ is $CE=s-c=3k$, $IE\perp CA$, and $CI$ bisects angle $C$, so $\angle ICE=\dfrac C2$.
In the right triangle $CEI$: $CI=\dfrac{CE}{\cos\frac C2}=\dfrac{3k\sqrt{14}}{3}=\sqrt{14}\,k$. (Equivalently $r=(s-c)\tan\dfrac C2=\sqrt5\,k$ and $CI=\dfrac{r}{\sin\frac C2}$.)
originality_note: New: the scale of a triangle known only up to similarity (from a sine ratio) is fixed by the distance from a vertex to the incentre, through the right triangle formed by the vertex, the incentre and the point of contact (way 5: sine law, cosine rule, half-angle formula and incircle geometry in one chain). Closest known: 'sides in ratio, given inradius or circumradius, find the area'. Different because: the given length is CI, which needs the half-angle of C and the tangent length s - c.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, side, angle and symbol is introduced before use, all conditions are stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Checked that the triangle 14, 16, 18 has CI = 2 sqrt14 exactly. Changed: No change.
key_step: Expressing CI as (s-c)/cos(C/2) and getting cos(C/2) from the half-angle formula to fix the scale.
justification: Four standard results chained in a numerical answer, with the incentre-distance relation as the less routine link; no casework. Above 2021-P1-Q18 (L2), below the inradius part 2023-P2-Q15 (L4).

concept_use.Sine Law: sin A : sin B : sin C = 7 : 8 : 9 gives a : b : c = 7 : 8 : 9.
concept_use.Inradius and incenter based questions: CI = (s-c)/cos(C/2) from the tangent length and the bisector through the incentre.
